C1283.title: Mass-Scale Theft of Online Short-Form Content Using Technical Means
C1283.summary: In April 2026, the Jiaxing Intermediate People's Court heard Zhejiang's first criminal case involving copyright infringement of online short-form fiction. Without authorization, Mao used scraping technology to download and collect more than 400,000 short-form novels from multiple platforms, built the 'Shuangyue Short Text' piracy website, and sold low-cost access through one-time, daily, weekly, and monthly access cards, making over 930,000 yuan from illegal distribution. The court convicted Mao of copyright infringement and sentenced him to three years in prison, suspended for four years and six months, with a 480,000 yuan fine.

references.title: Zhejiang's First Online Short-Form Content Copyright Infringement Case Is Heard and Decided
